authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI artifacts. The checkered pattern on the dogs ignores 3D volume and fur direction, warping unnaturally over joints (texture anomaly). The green dog's paws fuse with the checkered floor (structural collapse/fusion). The giraffe's neck lacks realistic cylindrical volume (perspective distortion). While stylistically coherent as a painting, these structural and textural defects reduce authenticity.
